method.clock: 60 distillStep calls per month, progress65/refill unless specified. No instant extraction. Scheduled starts at12/perYear intervals; refusal skipped, funds decision stops; no cash, stock, relation, order or age injection.
method.policy: One AmberTime brand, ordinary public actions; manual full target-age bottling or10 at6/rest24; configured retail tier. Approve ordinary shops from lawful offers, decline department. Monthly wait choices only. Production and retail formulas remain pinned baseline. B/C only automatic normal shipping function replaced in temp copy using a pre-retail order snapshot and pure fulfillment planner. Main runtime is never imported or edited by this script.
method.A: Original cap-purchase automatic shipping, including legacy supermarket subminimum shipments. Requested column is counterfactual eligible-catalog capacity, NOT an order generated by old engine.
method.B: Small fixed request: liquor3 monthly, supermarket10 everyfourth calendar month; per-line minimum applies.
method.C: Variable request from candidate shop-demand.mjs, seeded monthly pulse, age/flavor and actual paid-price factors; no inventory clamp; min/cap and one request per store. Only normal fulfilled orders create income.
method.stockouts: Month-end stock zero, with startup-inclusive and post-first-listing counts separate. Lost demand is not backlogged.
method.limitations: Finite deterministic policies, no fun/optimality claim. Department still declined solely to isolate recurring normal channels; its runtime unchanged. Requests refer to latest eligible historical release even after sellout/pruning; shipping remains FIFO per actual stocked lot.
